messages:
Cheng: heads up — monitoring fired for hosted-usw2 GPU pool. admission-control p95 queue jumped from ~120ms to 2.3s over the last 3m, p99 ~6s. GPU utilization ~92% and active queue depth climbing.
Mia: seeing it too on the dashboard. any obvious job floods? :eyes:
Cheng: not a single job spike. correlating with a spike in egress errors to eu3 — lots of `TCP RST` / 504s from our egress proxies around the same minute.
egree-monitor: alert: egress-nat-snats-exhausted-usw2 (count=28) — dropping new connections. link: https://dash.redwood/prod/egress/usw2/snats
Rajeev: SNAT exhaustion would cause upstream connections to fail and increase request latencies. that would stall KV cache warmups and keep workers holding context — explains queue growth.
Mia: can we enable burst-capacity for the pool while we triage? short-term relieve.
Olivia: note that enabling burst on hosted pools will spin up extra GPUs from reserved capacity and could increase spend for the hour. cost owner FYI.
Cheng: suggested immediate steps: 1) open NAT autoscale (if still gated), 2) enable pool burst, 3) reduce admission throttle threshold to shed noncritical load. doing step 1 now.
deploy-bot: runbook triggered by Cheng: `./scripts/infra/open-nat-autoscale --region usw2`
Rajeev: also patch a temporary affinity change so cross-region fallbacks don't hammer eu3; we should prefer local model variants to reduce cross-region egress. small config snippet:
```
route-policy:
  model_fallback:
    prefer_local: true
    max_cross_region_per_min: 10
```
Mia: applied the fallback policy change. watching metrics.
egress-monitor: recovered: nat-snats count normalized after auth -> autoscaler increased EIPs.
Cheng: admission p95 improved to ~180ms after burst + NAT fix. queue depth dropping. still tracking p99 tails.
Olivia: please annotate the incident with cost delta and which customers touched the burst capacity. I'll prepare a short note for finance.
Rajeev: follow-ups: - add SNAT saturation alarm earlier, - add per-pool egress counters to the GPU dashboard, - run a synthetic traffic test to validate fallback policy.
Mia: filed follow-up tickets: INF-4821 (SNAT alert), INF-4822 (per-pool egress metric), INF-4823 (blast test for fallback).
Cheng: thanks team. logging this thread into postmortem if p99 doesn't fully recover in 1h. :white_check_mark:
Olivia: noted.
